name: company-as-code
description: Reusable k3s multicloud GitOps company platform template

scripts.typecheck: bash -c 'if find scripts infrastructure -type f \( -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.tsx" \) | grep -q .; then bunx --bun tsc --noEmit; else echo "No active TypeScript sources"; fi'
scripts.test: bash -c 'echo "No automated tests configured for template-only repo"'
scripts.lint:workflows: bash -c 'if command -v actionlint &> /dev/null; then actionlint; else echo "actionlint not installed, skipping"; fi'
